'''Suprasteel''' was a molecularly-bonded material. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the industrial [[planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]] had [[factory|factories]] and blast yards that produced suprasteel used for [[starship]]s and by military garrisons.<ref name="Death-Hunter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Suprasteel appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] adventure "[[Death-Hunter]]," written by [[Tony Russo]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] [[1996]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Death-Hunter" />
